summary: Workaround for the Lightspeed chatbot 403: add CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS set to the platform gateway FQDN under spec.lightspeed.extra_settings in the AnsibleAutomationPlatform resource and wait for redeployment.
questions: How do I fix the Lightspeed chatbot 403 error?
How do I set CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS for Lightspeed?
Where do I put extra_settings for Lightspeed in the AAP operator?

answer_card.title: Fix Lightspeed chatbot 403 (CSRF)
answer_card.answer_md:
Edit the `AnsibleAutomationPlatform` resource and wait for redeploy:

```yaml
kind: AnsibleAutomationPlatform
spec:
  lightspeed:
    extra_settings:
      - setting: CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
        value: 'https://<platform gateway FQDN>'
```
